gigPicker.label: Gig
gigPicker.empty: No gigs yet - create one first

detail.heading: Invoice {{number}}
detail.finalizedNotice: This invoice is finalized. Voiding and re-issuing is required to make corrections.

lines.title: Items
lines.reverseChargeHint: 0% VAT — the customer accounts for VAT. Requires a valid VAT number for a customer in another EU country.
lines.viesHint: Before issuing, confirm the customer's VAT number is valid in VIES. The confirmation and number are stored as evidence; changing the VAT number requires a new check.

totals.reverseChargeNotice: VAT reverse-charged — Article 196 EU VAT Directive.

sentDialog.title: Mark invoice {{number}} as sent?
sentDialog.intro: Marking this invoice as sent has the following consequences:
sentDialog.finalized: The invoice is finalized — its details can no longer be edited.
sentDialog.ledger: The revenue and the receivable are recorded in the ledger.
sentDialog.forward: The status can only move forward to paid or void afterwards — it can never return to draft.

paidDialog.title: Mark invoice {{number}} as paid?
paidDialog.body: The received payment will be booked to the default payment account in the ledger.

voidDialog.title: Void invoice {{number}}?
voidDialog.intro: Voiding this invoice has the following consequences:
voidDialog.permanent: The invoice can no longer be edited, sent or paid — voiding is permanent.
voidDialog.ledgerReversal: A reversing entry is posted to the ledger, undoing the recorded revenue and receivable.
voidDialog.paymentLinkRemoved: The Mollie payment link is removed; the customer can no longer pay through it. If it turns out to have been paid already, the invoice is marked paid instead of voided.
voidDialog.correction: To correct a mistake, void this invoice and create a new one.

emailDialog.title: Edit the personal message
emailDialog.helperText: This is the personal accompanying text in the email message.

newDialog.title: New invoice
newDialog.description: Pick a gig to draft the invoice from. The band fee, venue address, and a default line description will be filled in.
newDialog.billingTargetDescription: This gig has both a festival and a venue. Choose which organisation to bill.

paymentLink.title: Payment link
paymentLink.notSaved: Save the invoice before creating a payment link.
paymentLink.amountRequired: Invoice total must be greater than 0.

errors.mollieKeyMissing: Mollie API key not configured. Go to Settings → Integrations.
errors.zeroAmount: Invoice total must be greater than zero.
errors.voidInvoice: Cannot create a payment link for a void invoice.
errors.alreadyPaid: This payment link has already been paid — the invoice is now marked paid.
errors.removeFailed: Mollie could not remove the link. Try again later.

pdf.retry: PDF render failed - click to retry
pdf.rerender: Re-generate the PDF from the current invoice data

ubl.downloadFailed: Could not generate the UBL file.
ubl.notReadyIntro: The file will download, but an e-invoicing network is likely to reject it:

warnings.missing_seller_endpoint: Your VAT number is missing, so the invoice has no electronic address for your band.
warnings.missing_buyer_endpoint: The customer has no VAT or Chamber of Commerce number, so the invoice cannot be addressed to them electronically.
warnings.unknown_seller_country: Your country could not be recognised. Use a country name or two-letter code.
warnings.unknown_buyer_country: The customer's country could not be recognised. Use a country name or two-letter code.
warnings.missing_seller_postal_code: Your post code is required for invoices sent from this country.
warnings.missing_buyer_postal_code: The customer's post code is required for invoices sent to this country.
warnings.missing_payment_account: An IBAN is required on invoices from this country. Add one to your profile.
warnings.de_domestic_contact_required: German domestic invoices must state a seller telephone number and email address. Add them under Profile → Financial details.
warnings.line_missing_name: Every invoice line needs a description.
warnings.vat_rounding_drift: The VAT per rate differs from the rate applied to its base by a euro or more, which validators reject.
warnings.endpoint_inferred: Electronic addresses are derived from VAT and Chamber of Commerce numbers, and may not match the participant IDs registered on the Peppol network.
warnings.missing_buyer_vat_id: The customer has no VAT number, which most business receivers expect.
warnings.buyer_reference_defaulted: No linked gig, so the invoice number is used as the buyer reference. Some receivers match on their own order number.

validation.lineRequired: At least one line with a description is required

issueErrors.incomplete_supplier_details: Add your band's name, street and city in the financial profile — an invoice must show them.
issueErrors.incomplete_customer_details: Add the customer's name, street and city — an invoice must show them.
issueErrors.invalid_lines: Add at least one line with a description and a quantity above zero.
issueErrors.missing_registration_info: Add your company registration number (and register office, where your country requires it) in the financial profile.
issueErrors.missing_supplier_vat_id: Add your VAT number in the financial profile — it must appear on an invoice that charges VAT or applies the reverse charge.
issueErrors.customer_tax_id_required_for_reverse_cha: Add the customer's VAT number — the reverse charge requires it.
issueErrors.reverse_charge_xi_services_unsupported: A Northern Ireland (XI) VAT number covers goods only, so it cannot carry the reverse charge for a performance.
issueErrors.reverse_charge_requires_eu_supplier: The reverse charge only applies when your band's VAT country is in the EU.
issueErrors.reverse_charge_requires_eu_customer: The reverse charge only applies to a customer in an EU country.
issueErrors.reverse_charge_requires_cross_border: The reverse charge only applies to a customer in a different EU country than your own.
issueErrors.customer_vat_number_country_mismatch: The customer's VAT number belongs to a different country than their address.
issueErrors.invalid_customer_vat_number: The customer's VAT number is not valid for their country.
issueErrors.reverse_charge_vies_check_required: Check the customer's VAT number in VIES and tick the confirmation.
issueErrors.reverse_charge_vies_check_stale: The VAT number changed since the VIES check. Check the new number in VIES and confirm again.
